audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Skill, Skill, Kennen, Kennen. Levels 4-5 and 6 were marked Skill under whys that say 'You keep the poke edge' and 'your biggest spike', and 2+ items was marked Kennen under a why that says she out-sustains and runs from your stun chain.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Kennen, Skill on 178 games at 56.18% — Kennen owns everything from level 2 until her AP items land.
audit.corrected: Rows 3 and 4 to Kennen, row 6 to Skill, as matched pairs in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet counted one sequencing cue in the whole matchup; the spike rows were the stock 'Liandry's Torment is your spike' template with no numbers.
audit.why: The timers that decide this lane are Slicing Maelstrom's flat 120s against Lilting Lullaby's 150/130/110s, plus Blooming Blows on 6s at rank 1 and Swirlseed on a flat 12s.
audit.corrected: Written into phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d so the all-in is keyed to real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three errors. (a) mid and wants.foe[1] treat Slicing Maelstrom as a channel Lilting Lullaby can 'break'. (b) The move speed is credited to her W in wants.foe[0] and mid ('kite with W speed'); it is Blooming Blows (Q) that grants stacking Move Speed. (c) Blooming Blows' true damage on the edge is never mentioned, so the player thinks MR answers her.
audit.why: Riot's text: Kennen's R 'summons a storm that strikes at nearby enemy champions' — no channel flag on the ability. Lillia Q: 'Passively, Lillia gains stacking Move Speed when hitting enemies with spells... dealing extra true damage on the edge.' W is a flat area slam with no speed component.
audit.corrected: The channel claim removed rather than reworded — sleep on you mid-fight is still bad, but it does not interrupt anything. Move speed re-attributed to Blooming Blows, and its true-damage edge stated in three places.

audit.whatIsWrong: The _missing feed proposes a 'Swirlseed cuts your retreat, hold Flash for the wall' line. I did not write it.
audit.why: The terrain flag on Swirlseed contradicts Riot's own description, which says the seed 'will continue rolling until it hits a wall or target' — it interacts with walls, it does not create them. Per the kit rules the description wins and the flag is a tooltip-parsing misfire.
audit.corrected: Swirlseed written up as what it is: a flat 12-second, 700-range slow. No terrain claim.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Blooming Blows's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: You keep the poke edge at 950 range, but the edge of Blooming Blows is true damage — MR will not soften it, so never stand in it.

edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is the matchup: pre-stack marks, E-in for the stun, and spend the flat 120s before Lilting Lullaby lands.

edits.before: This is your lane. Through levels 4-6 you out-poke her squishy body and at 6 your Slicing Maelstrom is the whole matchup: Q-W to pre-stack marks, E-in to stun, R to lock her and chunk before her R sleep can flip the trade. The key is forcing the all-in while her W/E are on cooldown — she has no hard escape, only move speed, so a clean E-Flash gap-close catches her. Bait her R sleep before you commit your channel; if she lands it on you mid-R the trade dies.
edits.after: This is your lane. Through levels 4-6 you out-poke her squishy body and at 6 your Slicing Maelstrom is the whole matchup: Q-W to pre-stack marks, E-in to stun, R to lock her and chunk before Lilting Lullaby flips the trade. Force the all-in while Watch Out! Eep! and Swirlseed are down — she has no dash, only the Move Speed off Blooming Blows, so a clean E-Flash catches her. Her sleep does not interrupt the storm, but eating it mid-fight still hands her the trade.

notes: Packet defect 'never names any of Lillia's abilities' is now partly fixed — Blooming Blows was already named, and Swirlseed, Watch Out! Eep! and Lilting Lullaby are now named in the rewritten rows. The Swirlseed 'terrain' flag in the kit file is a parsing misfire: Riot's text has the seed rolling UNTIL it hits a wall, not creating one. I did not write the _missing feed's 'hold Flash for the wall' line because it rests on that flag.
